Change the version a declared function is pinned to

## Usage

`circleci function update <alias> [flags]`

## Flags

| Flag                  | Description                                                                       |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `-c, --config string` | Path to the pipeline config file (default ".circleci/config.yml")                 |
| `-n, --dry-run`       | show the change without writing it                                                |
| `--jq string`         | Process values from the response using jq syntax (see `circleci help formatting`) |
| `--json`              | Output as JSON                                                                    |
| `--version string`    | version to pin (default: the latest release)                                      |

Global flags: `--debug`, `--no-color`, `-q, --quiet` — see `circleci --help`.

## Examples

- Move a pin to the latest release: 
  `circleci function update setup-go`
- Pin an exact version: 
  `circleci function update setup-go --version v0.6.0`
- Preview the change without writing it: 
  `circleci function update setup-go --dry-run`

## Details

Re-pin a declared function to its latest release.

The argument is the alias the function is declared under, which
`function list --pinned` reports.

JSON fields: alias, function, previous_version, version, config.
